name: Kanshi Spam Protection for Elementor Forms
author: Kanshi

sections.description:
Protect your Elementor Forms with Kanshi‘s intelligent, AI-powered spam detection. No CAPTCHA puzzles, no annoying challenges, and no changes to your form’s design. Simply connect your Kanshi Site Key, add the invisible Kanshi Spam Protection field to your Elementor forms, and let Kanshi analyze submissions and identify spam automatically.

Requirements and compatibility

This plugin requires Elementor and Elementor Pro 3.19 or later. It currently supports the classic Elementor Pro Form widget.

Elementor Pro is required because its Forms module provides the Form widget, custom field registration, and server-side validation lifecycle used by Kanshi to inspect submissions before Elementor processes its form actions.

Elementor Pro is a commercial plugin and is not available as a WordPress.org dependency slug, so it cannot be declared in WordPress’s Requires Plugins header. The plugin checks for Elementor and Elementor Pro at runtime and displays an administrator notice if either dependency is unavailable. It also avoids loading Elementor Pro classes when the required dependencies are missing.

Getting started

  1. Install and activate Elementor and Elementor Pro (version 3.19 or later).
  2. Open Elementor → Settings → Integrations.
  3. Enter your Kanshi Site Key, Get your free Kanshi Site Key by creating an account at Kanshi.
  4. Click Validate & Sync to verify your connection and synchronize your subscription information, including your plan and expiration date.
  5. Edit an Elementor Form and add the Kanshi Spam Protection field.
  6. Save your form. Kanshi protection is now enabled for that form.

The Kanshi field is invisible to website visitors and does not affect your form’s appearance or layout. Protection is enabled individually for each form where the field is added.

Supported forms

The classic Elementor Pro Form widget is supported. Elementor Atomic Forms are not currently supported.

External services

This plugin connects to the Kanshi API at api.kanshi.works to verify Site Keys, synchronize subscription information, and evaluate submissions from protected Elementor Forms. This external connection is essential for the plugin’s spam detection and subscription management functionality.

Site Key verification and subscription synchronization

When an administrator clicks Validate & Sync, the plugin sends the configured Site Key and the URL of the WordPress website to the Kanshi license verification endpoint.

If a Site Key is configured, the plugin also periodically synchronizes subscription information through a scheduled check every 12 hours.

The API response may include:

  • Site Key validity.
  • Domain authorization.
  • Website information.
  • Subscription plan.
  • Subscription status.
  • Subscription expiration date.

The Site Key is stored in the WordPress site’s options and is transmitted to Kanshi only for license verification, subscription synchronization, and spam validation requests.

Spam detection and submission data

When a visitor submits an Elementor Form containing the Kanshi Spam Protection field, the plugin sends the names and text values of eligible form fields to the Kanshi spam validation endpoint for analysis.

The plugin excludes:

  • Password fields.
  • WordPress nonce fields.
  • CAPTCHA values.
  • Kanshi protection marker fields.

File contents, client IP addresses, and user-agent information are not sent by this plugin.

Kanshi validation is performed only for forms where the administrator has explicitly added the Kanshi Spam Protection field.

Subscription eligibility is synchronized every 12 hours and cached subscription information is considered stale after 24 hours.

Service provider and policies

The Kanshi service is provided by Kanshi.

For information about data handling and service terms, please review:

  • Kanshi Privacy Policy
  • Kanshi Terms of Service

Create a Kanshi account

The Create an account button links to app.kanshi.works. No information is transmitted to that website unless an administrator chooses to follow the link.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Open Elementor > Settings > Integrations > Kanshi.
  3. Enter a Kanshi Site Key, save, and click Validate & Sync.
  4. Add Kanshi Spam Protection to each classic Elementor Pro Form that should be protected.
